summary: Approval under Section 62 read with Section 79(1)(d) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and under Regulation 15(1)(a) and Regulation 23 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 for truing up of the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 tariff period under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 and the determination of the transmission tariff for the 2024-29 tariff period under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 for the Transmission Assets under “Transmission System Associated with Nabinagar-II TPS (3X660 MW)” in the Eastern Region. **1. Bihar State Power (Holding) Company Limited,** Vidyut Bhawan, Bailey Road, Patna – 781 001, Bihar. The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 29.11.2024, had submitted the statement showing the computation of IDC, and the discharge of IDC liability up to the date of commercial operation (COD). Accordingly, the drawl of loan prior to the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (SCOD), i.e., 1.6.2019, was considered for the purpose of the computation of IDC. The said submission was taken on record while passing the order dated 15.1.2026 in Petition No. 498/TT/2025. 2. The Petitioner vide letter dated 5.5.2026, has admitted that the drawl date of loan “ _Commercial-335 SBI 04 (2018-19) (Q2)”_ was inadvertently mentioned as “3.9.2019” in place of “3.9.2018” in the statement with respect to Asset-3, showing IDC discharged up to the COD filed along with the supporting documents. Due to the above, there has been a consequential impact on the tariff components and the AFC trued-up with respect to Asset-3 for the 2019-24 and determination of tariff for the 2024-29 tariff period. Accordingly, the said inadvertent error is required to be rectified in exercise of the powers vested in the Commission under Regulation 54 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations 2023. Accordingly, we hereby rectify the inadvertent error occurring in various paragraphs of the order dated 15.1.2026 in Petition No. 498/TT/2025.
